summary: Chyrp Lite: a self-hosted PHP blog / web-publishing platform. Users live in groups that carry a flattened set of Permission rows; every admin action is gated by checking that the actor's group holds the right permission. Content = posts (core columns plus a key/value PostAttribute table) and static pages; optional modules add comments, likes, views, tags/categories and webmentions (pingbacks). A key/value Config table stores settings. Auth entity is User (login/password).

_no_edges.why: public password-reset endpoint; authorization is the HMAC reset token verified inside the body, no group/role wall (Main.php:1231)
internal hook fired when a post renders; no auth wall beyond skipping the post author, and nothing it calls back on (post_views.php:21-44)
public unsubscribe route; the auth is the HMAC token of the email compared inline, no session/group wall (comments.php:1255)
public endpoint with no auth/guard wall; reads a user by login, sends a password-reset email, calls nothing (Main.php:1178-1218)

the login IS the authentication operation — it checks password_verify(User.authenticate) and sets the session; exempt from view_site (Main.php:203,998). Has no separate guard/trigger because the credential check IS the operation.
the activate IS the auth operation — it verifies the HMAC token inline (Main.php:974) and updates User.approved; exempt from view_site. No separate guard layer.
